description: Ingredient aliases for must_include / must_exclude (SPEC §4). Directional: a constraint on a key also matches its listed terms, never the reverse ('nut' matches almonds; 'almond' does not match walnuts). 'aliases' apply to both include and exclude; 'exclude_only' entries over-match on purpose and apply to must_exclude only. Neither section is ever used for diet = gluten_free, which needs an explicit category. The table is a filter, not an allergen guarantee (SPEC §5).
